Qwen: Alibaba Cloud team building the Qwen family of open language and multimodal models
deepseek-ai: AI research company focused on open and efficient large language models
nvidia: Accelerated computing company releasing the Nemotron family and quantized open models
google: Google DeepMind's Gemma family of lightweight open models
zai-org: Z.ai, the team behind the GLM family of open language and agent models
meta-llama: Meta's Llama family of open foundation models
